newsitem.title: USA: First Union Real Estate buys 9 malls.
newsitem.headline: First Union Real Estate buys 9 malls.

text.p: First Union Real Estate Investments said Tuesday it has completed its $312 million acquisition of Marathon US Realties' portfolio of nine shopping malls in the southwestern United States.
The properties were acquired in a venture with affiliates of General Motors Corp's General Motors Acceptance Corp unit and Cargill Financial Services Corp.
First Union said its portion of the investment was $30 million, which was financed through a combination of internally generated funds and its recently expanded $96 million credit facility.

Under terms of the agreement, all properties will be managed by First Unio's affiliated management company, First Union Management Inc. Also, First Union retains the right to acquire the interests of the other partners after six months.
Marathon is a unit of Canadian Pacific Ltd.
